product_family: Cloud-based AI-powered customer communications platform with unified voice, SMS, and messaging. Features AI agents for 24/7 customer coverage, AI assistants for real-time coaching and automation, call center management, integrations with 250+ business tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, etc.), and healthcare-specific compliance (HIPAA BAA available).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2, Type II standards or its equivalent through independent, qualified third-party auditors. Aircall conducts at least annual audits.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Aircall's security program is aligned with ISO 27001 and SOC II standards. Aircall hosts Personal Data primarily in AWS data centers that have been certified as ISO 27001... compliant.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR applies to the Processing of Personal Data if and to the extent conditions set forth by Art. 3 of the GDPR are fulfilled. Aircall is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: For covered entities or business associates under HIPAA who plan to process protected health information (PHI), Aircall offers customers the opportunity to enter into a Business Associate Agreement. Designed to safeguard PHI disclosed pursuant to a business associate agreement in line with HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA – Compliant (listed on security certifications page)

certifications.name: CPNI
certifications.proof_quote: CPNI – Compliant (VoIP provider requirement for telecom carriers)

certifications.name: NIST Framework
certifications.proof_quote: NIST – Framework implementation (referenced as security standard alignment)

certifications.name: CSA CAIQ Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: CSA CAIQ Level 1 – Certified (250+ security questions)

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification on vendor domain, despite AI-powered product features.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Registry
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Cloud Security Alliance STAR Registry membership (CSA CAIQ Level 1 achieved, but STAR Registry not mentioned).

privacy.ai_training_note: Aircall does NOT use customer call data or recordings to train third-party AI models. However, product improvement analytics (transcriptions, usage patterns) are available for processing on customer data with express opt-out capability. Call recordings are anonymized (PII removed) before any AI analysis. Customers can opt out of analytics processing.
privacy.data_region: Primary locations: US (Oregon), EU (Frankfurt), Australia (Sydney). Data Privacy Framework certified for EU-US transfers. Uses Standard Contractual Clauses for non-adequate jurisdictions. Secondary transfers to India noted.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 (minimum) for all data transfers; TLS/SRTP for voice communications

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for all stored data

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) available; SAML/SSO support for enterprise customers

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC); block numbers functionality; audit trails for data access

security.name: Testing & Audit
security.value: Annual SOC 2 Type II audits; regular third-party penetration testing; active bug bounty program

security.name: Employee Security
security.value: Background checks required; NDAs for all employees; annual security and privacy training on onboarding

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS with 99.95% uptime guarantee; multiple availability zones for redundancy; regular backups across AZs

products.name: Core Platform (Team-Led)
products.data_scope: Call recordings, SMS, messages, customer metadata, CRM sync
products.notes: Traditional phone system with human agent leadership; modern, cloud-based; HIPAA BAA available on request

products.name: AI Assistants
products.data_scope: Real-time call transcription, sentiment analysis, coaching suggestions, automated CRM updates
products.notes: Live coaching during calls; call transcription/analysis; automated follow-ups. PII removed before any AI processing. Customer opt-out available for product improvement analytics.

products.name: AI Agents
products.data_scope: Call intent identification, autonomous resolution, escalations with context
products.notes: 24/7 coverage; handles routine inquiries; escalates complex issues to humans. Does not train on customer data for third-party AI models.

products.name: Integrations
products.data_scope: CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), ticketing (Zendesk), e-commerce (Shopify), business tools (Monday.com, Pipedrive, Microsoft Teams)
products.notes: 250+ native integrations; automatic conversation and customer data sync

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based (pay-per-user or per-minute); tiered by feature set and volume
compare.data_residency: Customer can select data region (US, EU, or Australia) at signup. Data Privacy Framework & SCCs enable compliant processing in non-adequate jurisdictions.

flags: HIPAA is NOT automatic—customers must explicitly notify Aircall and execute a separate Business Associate Agreement before processing PHI. Homepage marketing lists 'HIPAA' but fine print reveals BAA requirement. Fair practice, but homepage could be clearer.

AI governance certifications (ISO 42001, CSA STAR Registry) are not held or promoted despite AI-centric product. This is normal for most vendors but worth noting for AI-specific compliance evaluation.
AI training posture is strong (no third-party training, customer opt-out for analytics) but should be verified in customer contracts before deployment.

Data Privacy Framework compliance claimed but now suspended (effective July 2024); however, SCCs provide lawful basis. Advise customers to verify Aircall's GDPR transfer mechanism at contract signature.
